crossRefs.note: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished throughout all its parts, and…

translations.web: So he built the house, and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.
translations.bsb: So Solomon built the temple and finished it, roofing it with beams and planks of cedar.
translations.kjv: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
translations.asv: So he built the house, and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.
